sections.Profile:
"Excalibur" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in September 1988. It features a medieval fantasy theme with four flippers, one ramp, and a two-ball multiball mode. The machine is part of the Gottlieb System 80B series and was designed by John Trudeau and Jon Norris, with artwork by Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell. A total of 1,710 units were produced.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1988
